## Checklist

Before submitting this PR, please make sure:

- [ ] I have run `npm run validate` locally and all skills pass validation
- [ ] The skill name follows the convention: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only
- [ ] The directory name matches the skill `name` in the YAML frontmatter
- [ ] The skill includes both `name` and `description` in the YAML frontmatter
- [ ] I have followed the [Contributing Guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md)

## Type of Change

- [ ] New skill
- [ ] Update existing skill
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Tooling / CI improvement
